actualReaderBoundaries.actualBehavior: Reads only config.mappingPaths and mapping.decisions. Requires reviewer/reviewedAt/rationale before the mapped filter, requires complete decision coverage, then document.official===true. It neither reads sourceKind nor authorProposals. A mapped witness is labelled profileBasis:source-metadata. Our empty decision lists fail complete review coverage; fabricating mapped/reviewed/official data to pass is forbidden.

Current original-source selection comes from the checked input companion mappingPaths. Only decision:mapped rows contribute and only official URLs are emitted. sourceKind is not emitted as an authorship distinction. A non-official author declaration must not masquerade as an official original source.

Existing profileBasis variants are source-metadata and authored-view. The authored-view fallback is explicitly limited to BB/BE, not an authorization for BY/HE authored extensions. Generated sourcePaths and navigation derive from the actual scoped union; this task does not regenerate them.

minimumSeparateReaderDesignToReview: Keep official normative antecedents and authored component/course declarations as different provenance routes. Preserve the original source duty, source course, source exclusions and whole partner unions.

Decide source/course applicability independently on all eight actual author components and the complete four-goal material context. Preserve the HE2027 and Nernst exclusions; a model contribution is not full official coverage.

If a future source-atlas reader is asked to display adopted authored components, add an explicit authorship-preserving route and visible role; do not relabel them source-metadata or make their documents official.
Review the corresponding original-source output route so it cannot turn authored material into an official quotation/link. Retain ordinary official-source evidence as context.

Only after that separate implementation/adoption bind an isolated matching book input companion and generated manifest. No count change, target removal, prerequisiteOnly conversion or core:false trick in this candidate.
